title: Completeness of the BLR Function Tester
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:(\mathbb F_2)^n\to\mathbb F_2$ be linear, so that $f(x+y)=f(x)+f(y)$ for all $x,y\in(\mathbb F_2)^n$. The BLR tester that samples a uniform pair $x,y$ and checks whether $f(x)+f(y)=f(x+y)$ accepts with probability $1$.
hypotheses_covered: The function f is linear over the two-element field
